semiconductor_relevance: High — ISDI specializes in high-performance CMOS image sensors and X-ray detectors, which are critical components in various semiconductor applications.
summary: ISDI GmbH Austria focuses on the design and development of high-performance CMOS image sensors and X-ray detectors for medical, industrial, and scientific applications. Their offerings include custom ASIC solutions and sensor-based technologies that cater to demanding imaging requirements.

regional_presence.Austria: ISDI has established a dedicated R&D center in Austria to enhance its design capabilities.
